omittedResponsibilities: Only the currently implemented concrete-item automatic character insertion branch is ported. Iteration113 introduces the document-owned automatic character StylePool and IStyleAccess/SwStyleManager owner. Concrete SET-only parent-root/item-child/leaf-clone insertion shares handles for shareable items and retains fresh leaves for non-shareable items. Ordinary character creation and browser snapshot decode now use the document pool. SwFormatAutoFormat is non-shareable, retains explicitly supplied handles, copies the shared reference and compares pointer identity rather than item-set value equality. Independent real-owner regressions cover insertion/parent/input/copy/adjacent-range/codec contracts; one obsolete raw-value merge expectation is corrected. Selective reset pool interning, sentinel-bearing style insertion, native unordered iterator order/collisions, paragraph/ignorable families, unused-style enumeration, name/cache/lifetime semantics, native null default constructor and UNO name QueryValue remain unverified. Browser item-record persistence remains the existing adapter; full modules/model/layout/notification/filter/UI parity is not certified. Registered save/open/recovery deviations and existing semantic statuses/defaults/exceptions remain unchanged.
